content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Walk the Avenue of the Dead and climb the Pyramid of the Sun for a view that has watched over this valley for centuries."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"The castle crowns the hill with murals, marble and a view that makes the city feel like a rumour below."},{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Casa Azul wraps you in cobalt walls, folk art and the quiet stubbornness of Frida's world."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The heart of the city, where the flag waves over centuries of stories."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Walk among Aztec ruins right beside the cathedral, layers of history underfoot."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A market full of strange fruits and local chatter, perfect for curious noses."},{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Crispy pork tacos al pastor, a classic bite to end the first wander."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Glide the old canals on a painted trajinera, with birdsong and floating vendors all around."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Bright, lively plates and a room that hums with local chatter."},{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A proper neighbourhood market, all sizzling comales, fruit piles and friendly haggling."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander under ahuehuete trees and watch the city breathe in its biggest green lung."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Stroll leafy streets of art deco facades, tiny cafés and slow Sunday energy."},{"poi_id":"p17","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A long, theatrical tasting that turns Mexican ingredients into tiny works of art."}]}
Your guide in Mexico City: we welcome, we climb, we float, we Frida — every must-do tucked in, no corners cut.
